textField: DESIGN-POSITIONS.positions[].scope verbatim; reasons retained in original source

clauses.text: Scope, order and prerequisites: one separately authorized stage in the fresh T5, steps P1 P0 Q5 K5a K5b K5M K5g H5 Z51 Z52 once each in order, only after the K4H actual-result review closed with KH3 10/10, KH6 PASS and no relation-level security finding, after the root records two substantive agreeing positions on the K5 clauses and an exact crypto authorization naming DV-K2-1-R. Nothing in K5 proves, verifies, pairs, publishes a key or touches any ledger, wallet or network.

The run view sbx_run exactly as implemented in Q5, K5a, K5b and K5M: no toolchain, cargo home, registry, target, home or host path; read-only bin and in; writable out and keys only; synthetic /dev, tmpfs /tmp, loopback-only networking, stdin /dev/null; probed in full by Q5 before any mori-k2 compile runs.

Bounded first setup measurement: K5a and K5b at CPU/wall 600/900, Q5 at 120/300, host steps at 300/600 or less, and K5M as one process with RLIMIT_AS 8 GiB, RLIMIT_CORE 0, nice 10, RLIMIT_CPU 3600 s, wall 3600 s plus kill-after 60 s, GNU time inside the view, and the 10 GiB MemAvailable and 6 GiB disk gates immediately before. One attempt, zero retries, no cap change.

Classification as implemented by the step texts and gate verdict mapping: P1/P0 precondition refusals are BLOCKED(prerequisite); Q5 failure BLOCKED(capability); pin, binary, descriptor and root-record mismatches BLOCKED(identity); K5g STOP-CUSTODY BLOCKED(hygiene), STOP-IDENTITY BLOCKED(identity), FAIL-PREDICTION FAILED(prediction), and a gate run without a verdict BLOCKED(environment); K5M timeout, SIGKILL, SIGXCPU or allocation failure BLOCKED(resource); a getrandom failure is BLOCKED(abnormal-exit) and takes precedence over any generic failure label; any other signal death or panic is BLOCKED(abnormal-exit); a mori-k2 refused: or usage: outcome is FAILED(prediction) except an I/O refusal naming a path P0 verified, which is BLOCKED(layout); H5 classifies nothing; Z51 and Z52 failures are BLOCKED(hygiene), after which no K5 result qualifies. No BLOCKED class is ever FAILED. Scripts record; the fresh actual-result reviewer classifies from the full logs.

Custody, retention and publication: all operator source is pinned by the root before use and re-verified in final hygiene; T5/w is retained unchanged until the K5 actual-result review closes; the proving key is recorded only by path, mode, size, link count and SHA-256 behind lstat and O_NOFOLLOW guards, and only when the custody guard permits; leftovers of a failed invocation stay in place, are recorded the same way and are never reused; no step deletes anything; publishable material is logs, journals and receipts only, never w, binaries, keys, caches or host files; key deletion is a later separately reviewed exact custody step at review close unless that review names a retaining follow-up.

Setup gate K5g exactly as implemented in data/k5g_gate.py: a regular non-link record of at most 1 MiB in strict JSON with exact format, trust profile, notice and driver strings verified against the pinned driver source, relation equal field for field to the stage-C descriptor K4b-descriptor.json, 488-byte verifyingKeyHex with bytes 336..344 equal to 0300000000000000 and recomputed BLAKE2b-256 equal to vkDigestBlake2b256, stdout observedR1csSha256 equal to e458153e..., and exactly one regular non-link 0600 proving-key file whose size and SHA-256 equal the record. Key bytes are hashed in chunks and never stored, printed or copied.

Provenance honesty: the gate records the chain predicateDigest, descriptor r1csSha256, Cargo.lock 39b7db9b..., toolchain 1.99.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, the KH2 release mori-k2 SHA-256, observedR1csSha256 and the VK digest as declared provenance, with consumerCanCheckVkToMatrixLink false. The gate claims no VK-to-matrix verification, no subgroup or pairing validation, and no financial, ledger or deployment meaning for the setup.
